article_title: 'We're so proud of him' says sister of Emmy history-maker Matthew Rhys

tasks.prompt: Why was Matthew Rhys's Emmy night described as historic?
options: He became the first person to win two lead-acting Emmy prizes in one night
He presented every award at the ceremony
He won a prize for directing a film about Cardiff
He became the first Welsh actor ever nominated for television
tasks.correct_answer: He became the first person to win two lead-acting Emmy prizes in one night
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, ריס היה הראשון שזכה בשני פרסי אמי למשחק בתפקיד ראשי בערב אחד.

tasks.prompt: Which two programmes earned Rhys his lead-acting awards?
options: The Americans and The Diplomat
The Beast In Me and Widow's Bay
BBC Radio Wales and Netflix News
The Beast In Me and The Americans
tasks.correct_answer: The Beast In Me and Widow's Bay
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הפרסים היו על תפקידו בסדרה המוגבלת The Beast In Me ובקומדיה Widow's Bay.

tasks.prompt: What does Rachel mean when she says the family were “pinching ourselves all week”?
options: They were injured during the ceremony
They were trying to stay awake all night
They could hardly believe the good news was real
They were rehearsing an acting role
tasks.correct_answer: They could hardly believe the good news was real
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר פליאה ושמחה כה גדולות עד שקשה להאמין שהדבר אמיתי.

tasks.prompt: In Rachel's advice that Rhys “cannot wing it”, what does “wing it” mean?
options: Thank his family publicly
Speak in Welsh
Attend after-parties
Improvise without preparing
tasks.explanation_hebrew: wing it פירושו לאלתר ללא הכנה; רייצ׳ל ביקשה שיכין נאום.

tasks.prompt: What moment made the Emmy success finally “sink in” for Rachel?
options: Watching the awards being engraved
Seeing a video of their childhood
Hearing her brother first audition
Reading a newspaper in Cardiff
tasks.explanation_hebrew: רייצ׳ל פרצה בבכי כשראתה חריטה של הפרסים, ואז ההישג נקלט אצלה.

tasks.prompt: What does “starstruck” mean when Rachel describes seeing Harrison Ford?
options: Angry at a famous actor
Overawed or excited in the presence of a celebrity
Disappointed by the ceremony
Frightened by bright lights
tasks.correct_answer: Overawed or excited in the presence of a celebrity
tasks.explanation_hebrew: starstruck מתאר התרגשות או השתאות במפגש עם ידוען.

tasks.prompt: Describe two ways Rhys's family shared in the celebration.
expected_points: Rachel accompanied him to the Los Angeles ceremony
His partner Keri Russell cheered his wins
They video-called his parents at home afterwards
Rhys thanked Rachel in an acceptance speech
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני פרטים מתוך השתתפות רייצ׳ל, תגובת קרי, השיחה להורים או התודה בנאום.

tasks.prompt: What details show that Wales remains important to Rhys despite his living abroad?
expected_points: He thanked the people of Wales in his speech
He ended with a Welsh expression of thanks
Rachel said Wales remains in his heart and home
She said Wales had long supported his career
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לבסס את ההסקה על הנאום ועדות אחותו, בלי לקבוע שעבר לגור שוב בוויילס.

tasks.prompt: Summarise Rhys's double win and Rachel's description of the family response.
expected_points: He won lead acting prizes for a limited series and a comedy
Rachel attended the ceremony and was surprised and proud
The family video-called parents at home
The engraving made the success sink in
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את ההישג, חוויית המשפחה והקשר לוויילס.

tasks.prompt: Explain why Rachel called the evening unforgettable, using three specific moments.
expected_points: She watched a historic double win
Rhys thanked her in a speech
She was starstruck by Harrison Ford
The family spoke to their parents by video
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית שלוש דוגמאות מהאירוע בלי להמציא רגשות או ציטוטים נוספים.
